subject.title: [Feature]: Per-bot context isolation in multi-bot Feishu groups - only record context when mentioned

question: Should Feishu add an explicit mention-only context policy, redefine requireMention history behavior, or defer this to a broader group target-attribution contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public Feishu configuration and documented group-history semantics, so automation should not choose the default or compatibility contract alone.

options.title: Add Opt-In Feishu Policy
options.body: Introduce a Feishu context policy such as mention-only context recording while keeping current default history behavior for existing groups.

options.title: Redefine requireMention History
options.body: Make requireMention stop recording unmentioned group messages by default, accepting a documented compatibility break or migration plan.

options.title: Defer To Generic Target Attribution
options.body: Leave Feishu behavior unchanged until the broader multi-agent group-context contract in related group targeting work is designed.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Feishu Policy
recommendation.body: Introduce a Feishu context policy such as mention-only context recording while keeping current default history behavior for existing groups.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently reviewed the adjacent Feishu multi-bot identity PR and are tied to the current Feishu mention-policy decision surface.
